Samira Khan: Noticed an inconsistency in the API ref for PATCH /v1/rerank: the example response shows `scores` as strings (e.g. "0.82") but runtime emits floats (0.82). This trips up the TypeScript snippet which types `scores: number[]`.

Jon Park: Oh yikes. Where is the example? can you paste it?

Samira Khan: Current docs response snippet: ```json
{
  "items": [ { "id": "a1", "score": "0.82" } ]
}
```
Correct response should be: ```json
{
  "items": [ { "id": "a1", "score": 0.82 } ]
}
```
This mismatch causes our generated openapi->ts types to be wrong for consumers.

Luis Ortega: Thanks. I can open a docs PR to fix the JSON example and update the TypeScript and Python snippets that parse scores. We should also add a short note under the response schema: "scores are numeric floats in [0.0,1.0]".

Samira Khan: Good. Also run a grep for `"score": "\d` across docs, I suspect a couple legacy examples still stringify numbers.

Jon Park: I'll add a linter check in docs CI to validate JSON code blocks in API refs: verify value types against the OpenAPI schema for that endpoint. If examples and schema disagree, fail the build with a helpful message.

Luis Ortega: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 title: "fix(rerank): use numeric scores in examples, add schema note". Changes: update response examples in API ref, update TS/Python snippet parsing, add param note, and add a single-entry changelog.

Samira Khan: Quick copy nit: prefer "floating point" rather than "numeric" in the param note. Also add a one-line migration hint: "If you previously parsed scores as strings, cast to float to avoid comparison bugs."

Jon Park: CI change pushed to PR: examples are validated against the OpenAPI example schema. I added a fallback that only runs in docs builds to avoid blocking authors who are prototyping.

docs-bot: PR created by luis-ortega: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 - "fix(rerank): use numeric scores in examples, add schema note"

Luis Ortega: Ran smoke tests against staging snippets, TS compile succeeded and Python example prints floats.

Samira Khan: LGTM from docs/consumer POV. Jon, can you monitor any real-world errors after deploy? We may want a short note in the changelog referencing breaking changes for very old clients that parsed strings.

Jon Park: Will add a telemetry rule to surface client errors related to score parsing for 2 weeks after deploy. Filed ENG-1195.

docs-bot: merged by samira-khan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/c7f8b2 - "merge: fix rerank score types in examples"

Luis Ortega: Deployed to staging. Closing thread after main merge. Thanks! :rocket:
